end.summary: Practised checking exact answers by estimating first.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and comparing an exact answer with an estimate. They used nearby thousands correctly in several examples and explained that small differences can still be reasonable. Kabir continued to mix up “close to the estimate” with “equal to the estimate,” and this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to estimate a calculation first, then explain whether the exact answer is close to the estimate rather than identical to it.
